entries.question: O P D ki jach keliya keya hota he sar
entries.answer:
KGMU mein OPD (Outpatient Department) se sambandhit jaanch aur prakriya ke liye neeche di gayi jaankari ka paalan karein:

**1. Online Registration (Anivarya):**
KGMU mein dikhane ke liye online appointment lena anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap in tareekon se appointment le sakte hain:
*   **Website:** [www.ors.gov.in](https://www.ors.gov.in) par jaakar appointment book karein.
*   **Mobile App:** ABHA ya Health Care App ka upyog karein.
*   **SMS:** "APPOINTMENT <NAME>" likhkar 8887019134 par bhejein.
*   **Helpline:** Kisi bhi madad ke liye 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333 par call karein.

**2. OPD Fee:**
OPD parchi (ticket) ka shulk ₹50 hai, jo sabhi booking methods ke liye ek samaan hai.

**3. Hospital Pahunchne Par:**
*   **Samay:** OPD counter subah 9:00 baje se 1:00 baje tak khule rehte hain (Shaniwar ko 12:00 baje tak).
*   **Dastavej:** Apne saath Aadhaar card aur mobile number zaroor rakhein. Agar aap shehar se bahar ke mareez hain, toh apne sambhandhit vibhag (department) ka valid referral letter saath layein.
*   **Pre-booking:** Wait time se bachne ke liye pehle se booking karna bahut zaroori hai.

**4. Jaanch (Tests):**
Doctor se milne ke baad, agar woh koi lab test ya investigation likhte hain, toh aapko hospital ke lab counter par jakar uska shulk jama karna hoga aur phir sample dena hoga.

**Mahatvapurn Suchna:**
Main ek AI assistant hoon aur chikitsakiya (medical) salah nahi de sakta. Agar aapko koi gambhir samasya hai, toh kripya turant KGMU ke OPD mein doctor se paramarsh lein ya emergency ke liye Trauma Centre (Gate 14) jayein.

Kripya apni suraksha ke liye chat mein apna Aadhaar number, phone number ya koi bhi niji swasthya sambandhi jankari share na karein.

entries.question: Booking appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, you can use any of the following methods. Please note that online registration is mandatory for OPD visits.

### **Booking Methods**

**1. Online Portal (ORS)**
*   **Website:** [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
*   **Process:** Register/Login → Select Uttar Pradesh → Select KGMU → Choose Department, Date, and Time slot → Enter patient details → Pay the ₹50 fee online → Download your appointment slip.

**2. Mobile App (ABHA / Health Care App)**
*   Download the app from the KGMU Play Store.
*   Register using your mobile number and follow the same steps as the ORS portal.

**3. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS in the following format: `Appointment [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
*   You will receive a booking confirmation via SMS.

**4. On-Site Walk-in**
*   **Required:** Patient's Aadhaar Number and an active mobile number.
*   **Process:** Visit the registration counter → Provide your details → Receive an OTP on your mobile → Pay the ₹50 fee → Collect your physical OPD slip.

### **Important Information**
*   **Fee:** There is a flat fee of ₹50 for the OPD slip regardless of the booking method.
*   **Timings:** OPD registration counters are open **Mon–Fri (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM)** and **Sat (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM)**. They are closed on Sundays.
*   **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral letter for your specific department.
*   **Avoid Delays:** Pre-booking your appointment is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

I was created by Dr. Ayush Yadav. If you have any further questions about specific departments or campus navigation, feel free to ask!

entries.question: How to become bpt
entries.answer:
To become a Bachelor of Physiotherapy (BPT) student at King George's Medical University (KGMU), you must follow the admission process for undergraduate courses.

**1. Eligibility:**
To be eligible for the BPT program, you must have passed the 10+2 (Intermediate) examination or an equivalent exam with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) as mandatory subjects from a recognized board.

**2. Admission Process:**
*   **Entrance Examination:** Admission to the BPT program at KGMU is typically conducted through a common entrance examination.
*   **Application:** You must monitor the official KGMU website ([www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org)) under the "Courses & Admissions" section. Notifications for the entrance exam, application forms, and the information brochure are published there annually.
*   **Counseling:** After the entrance examination, a merit list is prepared. Qualified candidates are called for counseling, where seat allocation is based on merit and reservation policies.

**3. Important Resources:**
*   **Admissions Portal:** Keep a regular check on [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php) for updates regarding the application window, exam dates, and eligibility criteria.
*   **General Queries:** If you have specific questions regarding the admission process, you can contact the Registrar’s Office at 0522-2253171.

Please ensure you are referring only to the official KGMU website for application forms to avoid fraudulent sites.

While specific percentage requirements can vary slightly from year to year based on the official Information Brochure, the standard requirement is typically a **minimum of 50% aggregate marks** in PCB for General/OBC candidates, with a relaxation (usually to 40% or 45%) for SC/ST candidates.

entries.question: Paper kaise hoga
entries.answer:
KGMU mein BPT (Bachelor of Physiotherapy) entrance exam ka paper pattern aam taur par **Objective (Multiple Choice Questions - MCQs)** hota hai.

Exam ke baare mein mukhya baatein:

1.  **Format:** Paper mein objective type ke sawal puche jaate hain, jismein har sawal ke liye 4 options diye hote hain. Aapko sahi option chunna hota hai.
2.  **Subjects:** Paper mein mukhya roop se **Physics, Chemistry, aur Biology (PCB)** se sawal aate hain. Kuch exams mein English aur General Knowledge ke bhi kuch sawal shamil ho sakte hain.
3.  **Level:** Sawalon ka star (level) aam taur par 10+2 (Intermediate) ki NCERT ya uske samkaksh (equivalent) syllabus par aadharit hota hai.
4.  **Language:** Exam aam taur par English aur Hindi dono madhyam mein uplabdh hota hai, lekin iski pushti aapko har saal aane wale 'Information Brochure' se karni chahiye.
5.  **Official Notification:** Exam ka exact pattern, negative marking hai ya nahi, aur kitne marks ka paper hoga, ye sabhi jankari KGMU dwara jari kiye gaye **"Information Brochure"** mein di jati hai.

**Aapko kya karna chahiye:**
*   Jab bhi KGMU ki website [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par admission notification aaye, toh uske saath diye gaye **Information Brochure** ko dhyan se padhein. Usmein "Scheme of Examination" naam ka ek section hota hai, jismein paper ka poora pattern likha hota hai.
*   Pichle saalon ke papers (agar uplabdh hon) ko dekhein taaki aapko sawalon ke kathinai star (difficulty level) ka andaza ho sake.

Main KGMU AI Chatbot hoon, jise **Dr. Ayush Yadav (MBBS, KGMU Batch 2019)** ne banaya hai. Aap samay-samay par website check karte rahein taaki koi update miss na ho.
